_note: Wording variant 'short' v1 (2026-11-05, Claude's text from main's request): the PR #77 questions shortened with the same conditions; merged by key into the built questions (instructions replaced; criteria texts replaced only for options the question already has).

criteria.true: Taps just outside targets or repeated on one spot, facing the screen.
criteria.false: Taps on target, or no taps (reading or talking).

criteria.true: Going back, revisiting screens, or long pauses without choosing while facing the screen.
criteria.false: Steady progress, or the system is busy.

visual_difficulty.instructions: Unable to see the screen well?

criteria.true: Leaning in, large text or high contrast on, taps far from targets.
Long time without input while facing the screen, or options opened and closed unused.
criteria.false: Talking to a companion, looking behind, or the kiosk is processing.

criteria.true: Accurate taps, steady progress, no long pauses.

support_choice.instructions: Pick one support for this window, or `none`. Earlier judgments of this window: `jev`.

criteria.wait_hold_timer: Pause the timer, show nothing (companion talk)
criteria.remaining_steps_notice: Show the steps left before payment (no popup)
criteria.delay_responsibility_notice: Say waiting customers are the store's matter (no popup)
criteria.highlight_next_action: Highlight the next action, one guidance line
criteria.defer_big_button_question: Show nothing; no bigger-button question while people wait
criteria.none: Nothing new; the user is fine or already helped
